note: Capsule benchmark. Each task is phrased like a person, not copied from a skill. `skill` is the skill a capsule should serve (null: no skill fits, so the capsule should return none and enable nothing). `code` lists files of lean-context's bundled fixture repo (bench/fixtures/repo there): a capsule that found a skill should carry at least one of them among its code areas. `split` was fixed, alternately by position within positives and within negatives, before anything was scored: `tuning` tasks are for looking at, `final` tasks are the numbers to quote and were not changed after a run, with one disclosed exception: the first run showed that every task with a `code` expectation had landed in `tuning` (the alternating assignment could not see that), so four code tasks were added to `final` afterwards, in new wording, before anything was tuned against the tuning code results. Negatives include traps that share a word with a skill (review, triage, alert, coin, pull request, release). Run with `npm run capsule`; it needs skills-router and lean-context checked out next to this repository.
